# FDG7017

> DO NOT create and throw new exceptions just to have your feature name in the exception type or namespace name.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2 Choosing the Right Type of Exception to Throw.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: the reason for a new exception type is intent.
